US_label.finding: Sertraline (Zoloft) U.S. label v7 (2023-08-08) includes sexual dysfunction in Warnings and Precautions (5.11) and Adverse Reactions (6.1) but describes symptoms during treatment only; a full-label search found no mention of persistent sexual dysfunction, post-SSRI sexual dysfunction, or PSSD.

US_regulator.finding: FDA's quarterly potential signal lists (2023 Q1–2026 Q2) and Sentinel Initiative contain no signal for sertraline or SSRIs with persistent sexual dysfunction.
